name: Bangor Region YMCA Summer Camps
description_short: The Bangor Region YMCA runs several summer camps. It has three day camps: Camp Acorn (entering K–3rd grade), Camp G. Peirce Webber (entering K–6th) and Adventure Day Camp (entering 5th–10th). It also runs Camp Jordan, an overnight camp for ages 7 through 12th grade, which includes Mini-Camp, Sleep Away Camp, Adventure Seekers and Leaders School.
activities: Exploring Maine and visiting Camp Jordan (Adventure Day Camp)
Overnight camp programs: Mini-Camp, Sleep Away Camp, Adventure Seekers
Leaders School for middle and high schoolers
